title: Forever Add-on Catalog: confirmed versions
description: confirmed.json: for add-ons downloaded from CurseForge or Wago, the version and zip hash players reported and the maintainer confirmed, by catalog ID, source and edition. It changes only through a reviewed pull request (the reports workflow opens one); the generator copies it into catalog.json's sources.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the zip players downloaded, lowercase hex.

date.description: The day the confirmation pull request was opened (YYYY-MM-DD).

reports.description: How many reports (messages, not people) named this version and hash.
